violations.why: irq_fjord can preempt the task between its two reads of v_kestrel in fn_indigo and fn_saffron, so the two computations see different values.
irq_beacon can preempt the task and write v_iris between the read in fn_indigo and the read in fn_saffron.
irq_beacon can write v_iris between the two reads in the area computation, so the area uses inconsistent values.
